catalog._doc: Relation catalog for sampling ZebraLogic entities from Wikidata. value_pools: candidate values per ZebraLogic attribute (relabelling keeps the puzzle's own phrasing). person_relations: (famous person) -[property]-> value triples, used to retype an attribute and fill Name with real people (world-grounded aligned / conflict). name_pools: given names by gender / language. Query types: class = items matching `pattern` (binds ?x) with >= min_sitelinks; usage = values of `property` ranked by number of statements (optional `subject` pattern on ?s, optional `filter` pattern on ?x); demonym = countries used in P27 projected to English demonyms (P1549).

Pet.pattern: { ?x wdt:P366 wd:Q39201 } UNION { ?x wdt:P31|wdt:P279 wd:Q622852 } UNION { ?x wdt:P279 wd:Q39201 }

gender_stats._doc: female share P21 among an arbitrary sample of up to N holders of each occupation (P106). Empirical skew in Wikidata, used as a data-driven stand-in for occupational gender stereotypes.
